propositions: T3 and T10 criteria have never blocked in ~2500 runs each due to configuration, not quality, despite 13/20 T3 samples and 62% of T10 strong findings being actionable codebase-grounded criticisms
T3 and T10 blocking is enabled by setting default_posture to blocking with block_threshold 0.90 in criteria_routing.json

T10 class scoping to MAJOR severity findings (destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret on committed path, unauthenticated internet-reachable service) is achieved through severity guidance in plan_review_T10.md, preventing lesser findings from crossing the 0.90 priority threshold

T10 DetGateRule infra-vocabulary gate with terraform/cloudformation/IAM/kubernetes/GHA keywords and related infrastructure terms is added to det_gate_rules.py to pre-gate T10 LLM routing on infrastructure-touching plans

Pinned assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py are updated to reflect T3/T10 blocking configuration and approved-blocking criteria set, with a third pin in test_impact_model_versioning.py also corrected

Unit tests validate T3 and T10 findings at priority 0.92 block while those at 0.85 stay advisory, T10 DET gate fires on terraform and GHA fixtures while skipping pure-docs plans, and rubric severity guidance is present
